rules.behavior: Durability damage requires authoritative per-instance durability, validates ownership, rejects non-positive damage, floors at zero, and rolls back on validation failure.
rules.character_save_impact: Persists current durability and broken metadata in RuntimeItemInstance.
rules.world_state_impact: Item instance mutation is included in item-world snapshots.
rules.safe_fallback: Reject items without projected durability state.

rules.behavior: A durability transition to zero records broken=true without inventing combat-side modifier suppression or destruction.
assumptions: Combat and equipment formula owners decide the final effect of a broken item.
rules.safe_fallback: Preserve the instance and expose broken state.

rules.behavior: Repair requires authoritative maximum_durability metadata, caps current durability at that maximum, and clears broken state only after durability becomes positive.
supporting_evidence: Existing evidence-gated maximum charge and stack policy
assumptions: The native maximum and repair pricing/formula are not projected yet.
rules.safe_fallback: Reject repair when maximum_durability is absent.
rules.character_save_impact: Persists repaired durability and removes stale broken metadata.
rules.world_state_impact: No implicit currency, merchant, or timer mutation.

source_observations.native_dependency: Classic durability field mapping, wear formulas, repair formulas, pricing, breakage effects, and destruction behavior remain unresolved.
